items.title: Sysco (SYY) Could Be 9% Undervalued As AI Growth Plans Take Shape
items.summary: Sysco (SYY) has put artificial intelligence at the center of its next phase, targeting 6% to 7% fiscal 2027 sales growth and US$100 million in savings from AI enabled productivity projects. items.title: Will Sysco’s (SYY) AI Push and Buyback Pause Reshape Its Capital Allocation and Growth Narrative?
items.summary: Sysco recently suspended its share repurchase plan, affirmed a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.55 per share for October 2026, and expanded its Board to 13 directors by adding AI- and finance-focused leaders Jason Murray and Tom Ondrof.
